svg.text: Eight operators, each reading a full frame from DDR and writing one back.
8 operators -> 8 full-frame DDR passes = ~2.1 GB per frame. At FIC_0's ~800 MB/s the bus alone sets the floor.

None of these operators is wrong. FOUR are pointwise or pure addressing -- window, azimuth gather, detect, CT#2 -- so each pays a 256 MB round trip for work that could ride inside a pass already moving the data. That is what the next slide removes.
